content.short: Clave provides a single app to manage both crypto and dollars.
content.description: Clave is a non-custodial smart wallet that uses Account Abstraction and hardware-level security elements (such as Secure Enclave and Android TrustZone) to simplify on-chain interactions. It provides a user-friendly, secure bridge to seamlessly bring assets into daily life, delivering a comprehensive fintech solution and a holistic financial experience for all. Built to scale with the next billions, Clave aims to combine everyday usability with strong security across multiple chains.
content.meta: Clave is a noncustodial wallet using Account Abstraction and hardware security to simplify use. Discover Clave and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
